zh: 所有候选片段长度都是 3，所以开始得越早的片段也结束得越早；这正是区间调度里“最早结束优先”能取到最优的情形。
从左到右扫描，遇到第一个和为 0 的三连片段就选它，然后跳过这三个位置；否则只向右移动一格。交换论证保证贪心不比最优解差。
设下标 i=0、答案 0；当 i+2<n 时检查 A[i]+A[i+1]+A[i+2] 是否为 0：是则答案加一、i 加 3，否则 i 加 1；循环结束输出答案。
en: Every candidate segment has length 3, so a segment that starts earlier also ends earlier; this is exactly the interval scheduling case where taking the earliest finishing interval is optimal.

Scan from left to right: take the first contiguous triple with sum 0 and skip its three positions; otherwise move one position to the right. An exchange argument shows this greedy is never worse than an optimal answer.

Start with i = 0 and answer = 0; while i + 2 < n, check whether A[i] + A[i+1] + A[i+2] equals 0: if so, add one to the answer and advance i by 3, otherwise advance i by 1; print the answer at the end.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan from left to right for the first triplet whose sum is 0; once it is chosen, skip its three positions entirely; otherwise move one position to the right.

## Why it is correct

All candidate intervals have the same length, so the candidate that starts first also ends first. Replacing the first interval of any optimal solution with the earliest-ending candidate cannot create an overlap with the later intervals. Repeating the exchange argument on the remaining suffix shows that the greedy choice stays optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1) apart from the input.
